- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested binocular features for birdwatching:
  - Magnification of 8x to 10x
  - Lens diameter of 42mm
  - Lightweight design
  - Waterproofing and fog-proofing
  - Minimum eye relief of 15mm for glasses wearers
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended additional gear includes a birding field guide, birding notebook, packable rain jacket, and insect repellent.
